lift_rule: Raw swing knee target = amplitude*(existing knee flexion 0.82 * existing scale 1.75 + existing assistance 0.40)*sin(pi*post-gate phase/72) for phase<72; exactly 0.0 for phase>=72. No native-contact branch in this raw lift. Same old loaded peak, exact landing/stance endpoint; continuous value does not claim derivative continuity.
support_rule: V35's actual-floor, all-four-limb joint-compatible height intersection, lowering participants, support geometry, knee composition, neutral first reference and reference slew are unchanged. Record the V36 lift mode in an optional support receipt field omitted by old policies. Distinct policy, profile, memory and top-level actuation receipt prevent crossed identity.
contact_rule: Native contact remains required and unchanged for phase progression, release and landing gates, dwell, timeout, synchronization and motor limits. Fixed-phase raw-lift independence is not contact independence of the entire controller or an alternate physical trajectory.
preserved_limits: Existing amplitude cap, startup ramp, hip direction, steering, joint bounds, gain, rate damping, maximum speed and effort, and same-body recovery handoff. No world, model, body transform, velocity write or solver reset is introduced.
verification: Full core tests, all 360 phase/contact pairs, 400 synthetic sequential inputs, and the actual exported DLL on all 400 V35 retained inputs; independently compare stateless/session bytes, unchanged height plans and gates, limits and older-policy outputs.
